title: Grateful Dead Live at Roscoe Maples Pavilion, Stanford on 1973-02-09
source: Recording Info: MR > R (Bob Menke) > R (Pat Lee); Transfer Info: Technics 1506 w/Lamb Labs Dolby decoder > WAV (24bit/96k) > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC; Mastered By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a trippy 1973 show highlighted by a smoking Dark Star → Eyes → China Doll sequence, tight Here Comes Sunshine and strong Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance – citing an inspired Dark Star‑Eyes‑China Doll trifecta, powerful vocal work from Garcia on Loose Lucy and Here Comes Sunshine, plus a fun, relaxed second set. The soundboard source is praised for its clarity and the “trippy” box mix with Phil’s bass and Donna’s delayed keyboards, making the recording pleasant to listen to despite a few lyric flubs.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical highlights and enthusiastic language outweigh the limited number of reviews; recording is noted as clear with no major flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear mix, trippy box effect with delayed keyboards praised; no complaints about muddiness or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Shows a flowing set that blends new 1973 material with classic jams, keeping the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s vocals on Loose Lucy and his guitar work throughout are praised; he opens the show with Row Jimmy.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is highlighted for its interplay with Donna’s delayed keyboards, creating a “wonder to behold” soundscape.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboardist (Donna) gets kudos for trippy delay effects that sit nicely behind Phil’s bass.
